ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with localized mid-intensity (light grey) regions; estimated macro-level ratio of 70:30 dark to light visible pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation at the distal tips and along the trailing margins; central regions of both lobes exhibit light grey base pigmentation heavily overlaid with dark, contiguous vertical and diagonal linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression; visible angle approximately 115 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth is null due to occlusion by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire visible trailing edge; amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips with a slight upward curl visible on the right lobe tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scars scattered on the mid-section of the left lobe and near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely mapped network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the ventral surface of both lobes in multiple orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located approximately one-third of the distance from the distal tip toward the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, thick dark 'T-shaped' or 'L-shaped' pigmentation mark located on the lower-inner quadrant of the left lobe surface.
